spans.s:
Edidhiṣuḥ-pati is a term occurring only in the Vājasaneyi Saṃhitā, where the commentator Mahīdhara interprets it as meaning the ‘husband of a younger sister married before the elder sister.’ Though this sense is probably correct, the form is doubtless, as Delbrück points out, corrupt. See didhiṣūpati.
Foot notes xxx. 9.
Die indogermanischen Verwandschaftsnamen, 569. n. 1.
